authority: User selected poster on the local decision board. Existing FRAME palette/composition is no longer visual authority; biography and functional project viewing remain preserved.
world: A personal poster wall using oxblood, mustard, moss, slate and cream; Unbounded display type with readable Manrope prose.
firstViewport: Zhanibek is the dominant subject; readable age, university and human introduction beside purposeful topic-sheet navigation. No project-cover hero, fake portrait or decorative credentials.
visitorPath: About, life outside code, then projects; direct source links and screenshot viewer remain usable.
signatureInteraction: Topic navigation hard-swaps whole colored sheets, with clear selected state, keyboard access, and no motion required to understand content.
responsive: Sheets retile into one column; text and controls remain readable at 320px. No giant clipped typography or horizontal scroll.
proofRequirement: Desktop/mobile previews and final site must be visually captured and inspected; bilingual content, topic selection and all five project viewers exercised.
certificates: Awaiting user files; no invented public count or badges.
